description: Atomically creates a private offer, commits a specific buyer, and immediately redeems the voucher in a single transaction via the OrchestrationHandler. Same prerequisites as create_offer_and_commit (sign_full_offer + EIP-712 signature). Use for instant-fulfilment private trades. Returns unsigned transaction data.

agentId.description: Optional dACP agent facilitating this offer. Omit or pass '0' if no agent.

buyerCancellationPenalty.description: Amount buyer forfeits on cancel, in same unit as price. Must be <= price. Pass as string.

buyerId.description: Numeric ID of the buyer entity. Use '0' for seller-initiated offers.

collectionIndex.description: Index of the seller's NFT collection for vouchers. Omit to use default (index 0).

committer.description: Ethereum address of the buyer committing in the same transaction.

gatingType.description: 0=PerAddress (each address commits once), 1=PerTokenId (each token ID can be used once).

maxCommits.description: Max commits per qualifying address or token ID. Pass as string.

maxTokenId.description: Max token ID (inclusive) for ERC-721/1155 criteria. Pass as string.

method.description: Gating method: 0=None, 1=Threshold (hold >= threshold tokens), 2=SpecificToken (hold specific token ID).

minTokenId.description: Min token ID (inclusive) for ERC-721/1155 criteria. Pass as string.

threshold.description: Minimum token balance required. Pass as string.

tokenAddress.description: Address of the gate token contract buyers must hold.

conditionalTokenId.description: Optional token ID of the NFT gate token used by this specific commit (for SpecificToken gating type).

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

creator.description: 'SELLER' (default) = seller creates offer. 'BUYER' = buyer-initiated offer, quantity must be 1.

disputePeriodDurationInMS.description: Duration in ms for buyer to raise a dispute after redeeming. Example: 604800000 = 7 days.

disputeResolverId.description: ID of the dispute resolver for escalated disputes. Call get_dispute_resolvers to list available resolvers.

drMutualizerAddress.description: Optional dispute resolver mutualizer contract address that pools resolution funds.

exchangeTokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token accepted for payment. Omit or use address(0) for native ETH. Call get_supported_tokens for valid values.

executionMode.description: 'direct' = standard on-chain tx (sign locally with your wallet → send_signed_transaction). 'metaTx' = gasless relay via Biconomy (send_meta_transaction). Defaults to 'direct'.

feeLimit.description: Max protocol fee the seller accepts in same token unit. Pass as string.

metadataHash.description: Keccak256 hash of the metadata JSON. Returned alongside metadataUri from the store_*_metadata tools.

metadataUri.description: IPFS URI pointing to the offer metadata JSON. Obtain by calling store_product_v1_metadata, store_bundle_metadata, or store_base_metadata.

offerCreator.description: Ethereum address of the seller creating this non-listed offer. Must match the seller's assistant address.

price.description: Offer price in the exchange token's smallest unit (wei). Pass as string to avoid precision loss, e.g. '1000000000000000000' = 1 ETH.

quantityAvailable.description: How many times this offer can be committed to. Must be 1 when creator='BUYER'.

resolutionPeriodDurationInMS.description: Duration in ms to respond to a resolution proposal before it expires. Example: 259200000 = 3 days.

bps.description: Royalty amounts per recipient in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Parallel to recipients. Total must not exceed 10000.

recipients.description: Array of addresses receiving resale royalties.

items.description: Valid Ethereum address (e.g. '0xAbCd...' or '0xabcd...'). Mixed-case addresses are checksum-validated; all-lowercase and all-uppercase addresses are also accepted.

sellerDeposit.description: Seller collateral in same unit as price. Released to seller on completion or forfeited on dispute. Pass as string.

sellerId.description: Numeric ID of the seller entity. Obtain via get_sellers_by_address.

signature.description: ECDSA signature over the offer typed data. Workflow: sign_full_offer → sign the returned typed data locally with your wallet (EIP-712) → use result here.

signerAddress.description: Ethereum address that will sign and send this transaction. Must match the wallet that will sign the returned transaction locally.

useDepositedFunds.description: If true, use funds already deposited in the protocol treasury instead of transferring from the wallet.

validFromDateInMS.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the offer becomes active. Example: Date.now() for immediate.

validUntilDateInMS.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the offer can no longer be committed to.

voucherRedeemableFromDateInMS.description: Timestamp in ms from which buyer can redeem. Must be >= validFromDateInMS.

voucherRedeemableUntilDateInMS.description: Timestamp in ms after which voucher cannot be redeemed. Set to 0 to use voucherValidDurationInMS instead.

voucherValidDurationInMS.description: Voucher is redeemable for this many ms after commit. Set to 0 to use voucherRedeemableUntilDateInMS instead.

name: create_offer_commit_and_redeem
